question: What claim is made about the practice of the soul being told to the addressee, O Bhairavī?
premises: This practice of the soul is said to be told.
inference: The practice of the soul has been told to you, O Bhairavī.
uncertainties: The agent of telling is not explicitly named.
plain_english: This practice of the soul has been told to you, and to you, O Bhairavī.
